REPAIR_REGRESSION_CHECK.NEW_BLOCKER: Adapter V1 lacks normative row-set completeness/bijection/cardinality invariants, so its declared lossless transform is not mechanically provable.

evidence: Adapter V1 INPUT_ROW_REQUIRED_FIELDS and FIELD_MAPPING define how an individual present row maps.
Adapter V1 PRECONDITIONS/FAILURE_RULES define invalid present-row behavior but do not require every Universe V3 normalized_finding_row to appear exactly once in output.
Adapter V1 OUTPUT_MANIFEST names source_row_count and rows but defines no equality invariant tying input normalized row count, source_row_count, and rows.length.
Projection V3 trusts adapter_status=VALID and derives the activation-sensitive P0 set from adapted rows.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.countermodel: Two implementations can consume the same complete Universe V3: one maps all rows, another omits one valid row and shortens source_row_count. The Adapter V1 text contains no explicit omission/cardinality failure rule distinguishing them.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.impact: An omitted open P0 CONTROL_BLOCKER can disappear before Projection V3 classification/counting, allowing an undercount and invalid zero proof.

REQUIRED_REPAIR: Add exact input/output bijection and cardinality invariants to the adapter contract.
Require source_row_count == Universe V3 normalized_finding_rows.length == adapted rows.length.
Require each input identity tuple finding_id/path/blob to occur exactly once in output and reject missing/duplicate/extra rows.
Bind Projection V3 or its successor to the repaired adapter blob and independently re-review.
